fields.why: Tables 1–2 re-estimate the vaccine–placebo VE and RR within the approved 32–36-week dosing subset, and the text concludes that limiting to that interval reduces preterm-birth risk, which supports B's stratified reading. A's comparison-only is defensible because the subset is nested in the full trial population rather than a complementary level.

The report names itself an ACIP recommendation; the systematic literature search and GRADE review are its evidence base, and the brief has no systematic-review value, so A's mixed/other adds no design. A rule that an evidence review inside a recommendation report stays under guidance or recommendations would settle it.

brief_issues: No study_design value for a systematic review or GRADE evidence synthesis; and analytic_depth does not say whether an estimate re-computed in a nested subgroup (approved dosing interval within the full trial) counts as within levels of a third variable.
